origin: Researcher-designed, 2026-09-22, per user request for a scalping strategy during the London or London/NY overlap session.
thesis: The London/New York overlap (13:00-16:00 London) is the highest-liquidity window in FX. Fast, high-conviction M1 momentum bursts in this window reflect concentrated institutional order flow and tend to see brief continuation before fading (short-horizon order-flow persistence) -- distinct from london_orb's failed multi-hour session-range-breakout thesis.
broker_clock_conversion: 13:00-16:00 London = 15:00-18:00 this broker's server time, constant year-round.

entry.trigger: a completed M1 bar's body >= max(MinBurstPipsFloor, BurstVsAvgMultiplier * rolling average of the last BurstHistoryWindow session bars' body sizes), AND body/range >= MinBodyToRangeRatio (filters wick-heavy bars)
entry.side: buy on a bullish burst, sell on a bearish burst (continuation bet, not a fade)
skip_conditions: computed lot size below broker minimum (never rounded up)

stop_loss: max(MinStopPips, burst body size in pips * SLMultiplier)
take_profit: burst body size in pips * TPMultiplier

exit.rule: market close MaxHoldMinutes (10 default) after entry if SL/TP not hit, or immediately at session end (18:00 server)

position_sizing.note: smaller than this project's day-trading strategies (0.5-1%) since scalping trades far more often per day -- caps cumulative daily exposure

consecutive_loss_pause.resume: first day of next month, or InpResetLedgerNow=true
consecutive_loss_pause.note: higher than gotobi's 6 given much higher trade frequency

tunable_parameters_to_sweep: BurstVsAvgMultiplier, SLMultiplier, TPMultiplier, MinBodyToRangeRatio, MaxHoldMinutes -- not yet swept, v1 baseline uses reasonable starting defaults pending an in-sample sweep.

demo_criteria.rationale: Scalping category anchor (40-50 trades / 10-14 days) from CLAUDE.md.
